title: Stable Influence Under Coordinate Permutation
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, let $\pi$ be a permutation of the $q$ coordinates, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^q\to\mathbb R$. For every coordinate $i$, the stable influence of the function obtained by permuting the input coordinates according to $\pi$ at $i$ equals the stable influence of $f$ at $\pi^{-1}(i)$.
